en.text:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers trigger a Kinetic Explosion at the target's location, knocking nearby enemies into the air and Disorienting them. 1 second cooldown between activations.

Explosion Damage and radius based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 439 Damage, 15m Radius 
• Elites: 598 Damage, 15m Radius
• Minibosses and higher: 717 Damage, 20m Radius
• Players: ?

Explosions have up to 20% decreased damage at the edge of the radius. Finishers upgrade the explosion to the one triggered by a Powered Melee on a one rank higher target.

Explosions triggered can chain on Kills and will trigger weaker explosions that deal up to <pve 242 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a 8? meter radius. Chain Explosions don't have a cooldown.
